attempts.summary: Established a manual file-integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (Alpine 3.23, AIDE unavailable in repos) using a custom baseline/check script pair recording path|type|mode|uid|gid|size|mtime|sha256(or symlink target) for every file, dir, and symlink under /etc, protected by its own checksum manifest. Verified detection works (modify+add test), reverted the test changes, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id, rebooted node1 via `reboot` with a background-delayed ack, polled until reachable, confirmed a new boot_id/uptime, and confirmed post-restart service health plus that the baseline manifest and /etc integrity check both passed cleanly.
